places.name: Waitwell
places.note: suggested for the Bus-strong county (county_a): where the province waits for the bus, and waits well

places.name: Gleamford
places.note: suggested for the Shops-strong county (county_b): its shop windows gleam

places.name: Cloche End
places.note: suggested for the Vegetables-strong county (county_c); a cloche is a glass cover for seedlings

places.name: Dawdlemouth
places.note: suggested for the Anglers-strong county (county_e): where the River Dawdle reaches the canal

places.name: Clatterby
places.note: suggested for the Bus-and-Brass county (county_f): buses and bands both clatter

places.name: Hampering
places.note: suggested for the Shops-and-Vegetables county (county_g): a hamper is a basket; hampering is what committees do (a sister to Dithering)

places.name: Wobbling Stone
places.note: written 'the Wobbling Stone': the rocking stone the province is named after; serves no club

places.name: Ribbon Steps
places.note: written 'the Ribbon Steps': the steps of the provincial hall, where every ribbon of the province is cut and every apology made; serves no club (an earlier 'Empty Plinth' was cut: with a numbered bandstand it recalled a real square's famous plinth)

places.name: Second Bandstand
places.note: written 'the Second Bandstand': nobody can find the first; Brass (comedy editor: was 'Fourth Bandstand', which echoes a real square's Fourth Plinth)

places.name: Tiptoe Jetty
places.note: written 'Tiptoe Jetty': the quietest jetty on the canal; Anglers

places.name: Unhurried Canal
places.note: written 'the Unhurried Canal': the province's canal (office-style.md 1)

places.name: Lingering Locks
places.note: written 'the Lingering Locks': a flight of locks on the Unhurried Canal; boats wait in them, anglers watch

places.name: Patient Glasshouse
places.note: written 'the Patient Glasshouse': the oldest of the glasshouses, in no hurry, like the canal; Vegetables (comedy editor: was 'Great Glasshouse', the name of a real botanic-garden building)

places.name: First Shelter
places.note: written 'the First Shelter': the province's oldest bus shelter, kept as it was and leaned on; Bus

places.name: Glass Arcade
places.note: written 'the Glass Arcade': a covered row of shop windows; Shops

runUp.text: Plant a tree in {district}. It will be photogenic in 40 years.
runUp.subject: gardens

runUp.text: Point at something in {district}. Rodney will say what, later.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Judge the {district} hats. Yours has entered. Declare an interest.
runUp.subject: hats

runUp.text: Open the {district} bridge. Again for the camera. Again for the minutes.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Pin the {district} show rosette on the winner. Not on you.
runUp.subject: vegetable-shows

runUp.text: Cut the {district} cake. The icing reads THE GOVERNOR CUT THIS.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Award the {district} prizes: best scone, best rose, best photo of you.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Sign the {district} roll of honour. Not the napkin; that is the law.
runUp.subject: paperwork

runUp.text: Sit by the water in {district}. Say nothing. You will be quoted.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Tour {district}: 14 benches, and not one has your name. Yet.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Break new ground in {district}. Gently; it is the bowling green.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Present the {district} band cup. We play you on. Off. And on.
runUp.subject: bandstands

runUp.text: Cut the {district} ribbon. Cuthbert needs both halves signed for.
runUp.subject: ribbons

runUp.text: Pose with the {district} prize pumpkin. Mind its good side.
runUp.subject: vegetable-shows

runUp.text: Open the {district} flower show. No ribbon. Put the scissors away.
runUp.subject: gardens

runUp.text: Ride the {district} bus. Wave at each stop. Each wave is logged.
runUp.subject: buses

rallies.text: A rally at the bandstand: 40 chairs, and one more for your hat.
rallies.subject: bandstands

rallies.text: A rally at the fête, on a hay bale marked GOVERNOR (KEEP OFF).
rallies.subject: signage

rallies.text: A rally on the green. Standing on it needs a permit. Queue on it.
rallies.subject: paperwork

rallies.text: A rally in the square. Rodney has had your soapbox raised, slightly.
rallies.subject: vanity
